weaknesses: The abstract overstates the generality of the claims regarding the improvement in perplexity on human texts without sufficient empirical evidence.
The paper does not adequately address the limitations of the proposed method, particularly in terms of computational efficiency and scalability.
The experimental setup lacks a comprehensive comparison with more recent decoding methods beyond the selected baselines.
strengths: The proposed framework, Daemon, presents a novel approach to aligning language model outputs with human text metrics, addressing a significant gap in current decoding methods.
The theoretical guarantees provided for the optimization problem enhance the rigor of the proposed method.
Empirical results demonstrate the effectiveness of Daemon across various metrics and domains, showing clear improvements over strong baselines.
